review_candidates.description: Vill du vara den som gör skillnad i våra kunders vardag? Servicedesk är hjärtat i Advitum. Det är hit de flesta av våra kunder vänder sig i första hand, och för många av dem är vi deras egen IT-avdelning. Nu växer vi och söker en servicedeskmedarbetare som vill vara med och ge branschens bästa support. Vi söker dig som tycker om att hjälpa människor och som får energi av att lösa problem. Du tar emot ärenden, felsöker, löser och följer upp, och ser till att kunden känner sig sedd och väl omhändertagen hela vägen. Du blir en del av ett sammansvetsat servicedeskteam och har alltid erfarna kollegor och specialister att bolla med när det blir klurigt. Du kommer att Ta emot och lösa supportärenden via telefon, mejl och ärendeportal Felsöka och hjälpa till med datorer, mobiler, skrivare och nätverk Administrera användare, behörigheter och licenser i Microsoft 365 Hantera och installera klienter, till exempel med Intune Dokumentera lösningar och bidra till vår gemensamma kunskapsbas Besöka kunder på plats när det behövs Vem är du? Vi tror att du Har erfarenhet av IT-support eller servicedesk, eller har en IT-utbildning i bagaget Har grundläggande kunskaper i Windows, Microsoft 365 och nätverk Är serviceinriktad och har lätt för att kommunicera i både tal och skrift, på svenska och engelska Är strukturerad och tycker om att följa ett ärende hela vägen till en nöjd kund Gillar att lära dig nytt och att dela med dig av det du kan Det viktigaste för oss är din inställning. Har du hjärtat för service och viljan att lära dig mer, så hjälper vi dig med resten. För många är servicedesk också en fantastisk språngbräda vidare mot rollen som tekniker eller konsult. Så jobbar vi För oss handlar jobbet minst lika mycket om människorna som om tekniken. Sedan starten 2010 har vi haft samma mål: att ha IT-branschens mest nöjda kunder och medarbetare, och vi tror inte att det ena går utan det andra. Vi har en platt organisation, korta beslutsvägar och noll prestige. Här är det självklart att ge beröm, hjälpa en kollega och dela med sig av det man kan. Och ja, vi tycker också att det ska vara kul att gå till jobbet, så när det går bra för oss firar vi tillsammans. Tjänsten utgår från vårt kontor i Växjö, men du väljer själv var du jobbar bäst: på kontoret, hemma eller hos kund. Du styr din egen kalender, kan träna på arbetstid och har en egen utvecklingsplan, både för tekniken och för det som är minst lika viktigt: kundrelationer, affärsmannaskap och projektarbete. Som en del av Aderian får du det bästa av två världar, närheten i ett lokalt bolag där alla känner alla och möjligheterna i en större grupp med kollegor och utvecklingsvägar över hela landet. Varför Advitum? Ett härligt gäng kollegor som både kan mycket och bryr sig om varandra Frihet under ansvar och stora möjligheter att påverka både din egen utveckling och hur vi jobbar Ett generöst förmånspaket med friskvårdsbidrag, träning på arbetstid och fokus på balans i livet Nära samarbete med Microsoft och våra systerbolag i Aderian-koncernen Medarbetare som trivs på riktigt: vår eNPS har historiskt legat mellan 90 och 100 Låter det intressant? Då vill vi gärna träffa dig. Vi rekryterar löpande och ser fram emot att höra hur du vill vara med och utvecklas tillsammans med oss!

We operate a portfolio of established channels with millions of subscribers and hundreds of millions of views, alongside newer channels we're actively developing and growing. Our content spans everything from documentaries, history, and true crime to entertainment and educational content. We're a small, ambitious team with a strong focus on creativity, audience engagement, and performance. We understand that succeeding on YouTube isn't just about making great videos. It's about knowing how to package those videos, capture attention, and consistently deliver content people want to watch. The Role We're looking for a talented  YouTube Thumbnail Designer & Channel Manager  to join our team. This is a hands-on creative role combining thumbnail design with the day-to-day management and growth of several YouTube channels. We're looking for someone who genuinely understands YouTube. Someone who knows what makes a great thumbnail, understands the importance of titles and packaging, and can look at a video's performance and identify opportunities to improve it. You'll be working across both established channels with large audiences and exciting new projects we're looking to grow. What You'll Be Doing Thumbnail Design:  Creating compelling, high-quality thumbnails designed to maximise click-through rates while maintaining each channel's visual identity. Video Packaging:  Working on titles and thumbnails together to create the strongest possible packaging for every upload. Channel Management:  Managing uploads, scheduling, descriptions, playlists, and general channel operations. Performance Analysis:  Monitoring CTR, impressions, audience retention, and other key metrics to understand what's working and what isn't. Testing & Optimisation:  Running thumbnail A/B tests, reviewing results, and continuously improving performance. Creative Collaboration:  Working closely with our editors, writers, and wider production team to ensure each video has the best possible chance of success. Channel Growth:  Helping identify opportunities, develop content ideas, and improve the overall performance of our channels. What We're Looking For Proven experience designing successful YouTube thumbnails, with a strong portfolio of previous work. A solid understanding of YouTube, including CTR, impressions, audience retention, and how the recommendation system works. Strong Photoshop skills or equivalent professional design experience. An excellent eye for composition, visual storytelling, and creating thumbnails that stand out. Experience managing YouTube channels and using YouTube Studio. The ability to understand different audiences and adapt your creative approach across multiple channels and niches. Someone who is organised, proactive, reliable, and comfortable managing their own workload remotely. Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with a small team. Most importantly, we're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys YouTube and understands the difference between a thumbnail that looks good and one that actually gets clicks. Experience growing or managing successful channels is a major advantage, but we're far more interested in what you've actually achieved than formal qualifications. Why Join KrakenMedia? You'll have the opportunity to work across a diverse portfolio of YouTube channels, including established brands with millions of subscribers. We're a growing company with ambitious plans, and we're looking for someone who wants to play a meaningful role in that growth. You'll have creative input, the opportunity to test new ideas, and the freedom to help shape how our channels look and perform. How to Apply Please send us: A brief introduction about yourself and your YouTube experience. A portfolio showing thumbnails you've designed, ideally with links to the videos they were used on. Examples of YouTube channels you've worked on or managed. Any performance results or improvements you've helped achieve. We're particularly interested in seeing real examples of your work and understanding the thinking behind your designs.

review_candidates.description: Job Description: Type of Requisition: Regular Clearance Level Must Currently Possess: Top Secret/SCI Clearance Level Must Be Able To Obtain: Top Secret/SCI Public Trust/Other Required: None Job Family: Network and Telecommunications Skills: Job Qualifications: DoD 8570 compliant, Networks, System Infrastructure, Technical Controls, Telecommunication Systems Certifications: None Experience: 5 + years of related experience US Citizenship Required: Yes Job Description: GDIT is seeking a Telecommunications Analyst Sr. to help the Network Support on our Joint Service Provider Enterprise Transport Management - Next-Gen (JSP ETM - NG) program at the Pentagon in Arlington, VA. The current shift is: Thursday through Saturday; 12hr shift, 6:00am to 6:00pm and every other Wednesday for 1 8hr shift (80 total hours every 2 weeks) Due to the nature of work this role entails, telecommuting is not allowed and will require the employee to report full-time onsite. HOW OUR TELECOMMUNICATIONS ANALYST WILL MAKE AN IMPACT: Detect, report, troubleshoot and repair to Pentagon Transport layer circuits in a 24/7 facility. Perform Operations & Maintenance responsibilities for complex Command and Control Networks. Work independently to troubleshoot and isolate complex network outages to minimize customer downtime. Develop and present modified engineering schematics to reflect current and proposed Network & Circuit design changes. Provision and re-route Command and Control Traffic to meet the needs of VIP & Flag Officer customer base. Perform Tier III level repair of communications equipment down to the card and port level. Perform administrative duties for Type-1 Encryption management network. To include Device firmware & software upgrades. Utilization of monitoring tools to provide both reactive and proactive support for the clients’ network and systems infrastructure. Provide hardware, computer systems, and electrical components support and operations in classified networks. Application of industry accepted standards and best practices related to Information Management Operations and with ITSM best practices. WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED – REQUIRED: Clearance: Active TS/SCI security clearance Certifications: 8570 IAT Level II certification Education: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, OR equivalent work experience Year's Experience: 5 years of related hardware engineering experience. Technical Skills: Experience designing and developing information processing hardware, computer systems, and electrical components Location: Full-time onsite at the Pentagon - Arlington VA. WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED – DESIRED: Military Technical Control Experience Experience operating and maintain fill devices including DTDs, SKLs, KYK-13s, KYK-15s, KOI-18s. Experience operate and maintain encryption devices such as KIV-7/7Ms, Fastlanes, Taclanes, Key Generators, and STE equipment. Demonstrated experience in an Information Technology environment. Knowledge and experience in digital and analogue circuit design and implementation. Experience in the analysis testing and troubleshooting TDM & TDMoIP circuits. Knowledge of IP and optical network operation. Must be knowledgeable of equipment to include transport systems (DWDM, SONET, TDMoIP and TDM), timing and sync, circuit test and analysis, electrical/physical interfaces, crypto, and circuit signaling. Must be knowledgeable of Promina/NX-1000 operation, provisioning, and installation. GDIT IS YOUR PLACE: 401K with company match Comprehensive health and wellness packages Internal mobility team dedicated to helping you own your career Professional growth opportunities including paid education and certifications Cutting-edge technology you can learn from Rest and recharge with paid vacation and holidays #ETMcareers #GDITcareers The likely salary range for this position is $93,662 - $126,500. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range. Scheduled Weekly Hours: 40 Travel Required: Less than 10% Telecommuting Options: Onsite Work Location: USA VA Arlington Additional Work Locations: Total Rewards At GDIT: Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. We regularly review our Total Rewards package to ensure our offerings are competitive and reflect what our employees have told us they value most. Our Identity Verification Process: As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during virtual interviews. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud. By proceeding, you authorize the collection, processing, and use of your biometric data for identity verification and security purposes. About Our Work: We are GDIT. A global technology and professional services company that delivers technology solutions and mission services to every major agency across the U.S. government, defense and intelligence community. Our 26,000 experts extract the power of technology to create immediate value and deliver solutions at the edge of innovation. We operate across 50+ countries worldwide, offering leading mission-ready capabilities in AI, cloud, cyber and software development.
